# Aether Visual Ceremony Configuration

This file controls the visual identity of the Aether colony system — emojis,
colors, labels, and ASCII art used when rendering output to the terminal.

## Editing Safely

- **Values only** — Changing an emoji or color code is safe and takes effect
  immediately on the next command.
- **Keys must stay stable** — The Go runtime looks up castes and commands by
  the exact keys shown above. Renaming a key will break rendering for that
  caste/command until the code is updated.
- **YAML structure** — Keep the file valid YAML. The frontmatter is parsed at
  runtime; malformed YAML causes a silent fallback to hardcoded defaults.
- **Missing entries** — If a caste or command is omitted, the hardcoded default
  is used as a fallback.

## What Each Section Controls

| Section | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `caste_emoji_map` | Emoji prefix shown before each worker caste |
| `caste_color_map` | ANSI color code (e.g. `33` for yellow) for caste labels |
| `caste_label_map` | Human-readable label for each caste |
| `command_emoji_map` | Emoji shown next to command names in banners |
| `caste_prefixes` | Name prefixes used by `deterministicAntName()` |
| `default_prefixes` | Fallback prefixes when a caste has no entry |
| `aether_wordmark` | ASCII art banner rendered on init and status |
| `visual_divider` | Horizontal rule string used between sections |
